title: TBGVtools basic
description:
a complete tools overhaul made by thatonecodeguy, bluerthanthesky, nottherealgeo and vulpin!
(3d original designs)
body:
a simple tools overhaul!

this texture pack makes tools 3d and have way cooler designs

please, dont copy any of our tool designs. you can take inspiration from it or upload videos/pictures to the internet with it.

why would you wanna download the texture pack? because these tools are very cool pretty high quality models, so its great for hardcore/server videos!

![better tools (not like this)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75ac0214bf54b17c4ab85d01d3e929839e8bea0a.jpeg)
